reuse.why: All four steps route through the existing shouldFillCategory / getCategoriesForAverage / getAllCategoriesWithGroupHidden selection, reuse averageToBudgetAmount and getSheetValue for the new action, and use extractTagsFromText for the tag.

duplication.why: Rules are added once in the shared predicate; the only repetition is the group_notes/goal_def fields added to both the getBudgetData query and getAllCategoriesWithGroupHidden, and the same optional flag threaded through each action signature.

placement.why: Template, #fixed and hidden rules live in the single selection predicate in actions.ts, the new method is registered in budget/app.ts next to its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the four requests; the old includeHidden option is replaced rather than kept, which changes setZero's hidden-category handling as a side effect of the rename.

maintainability.why: One predicate decides every exclusion with named options; a maintainer must still keep the two category queries supplying the same columns.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldFillCategory's includeHidden option is replaced by includeHiddenCategories (no net new option, no new branches); getCategoriesForAverage gains an includeHiddenCategories parameter; every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, calls the shared selection in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts.
